Redcon by Hexage is a game I happily paid $5 for. In fact, I'd recommend anything in the Hexage portfolio.

This game is similar to FTL, in that you manage little dudes who run around a base and operate systems to destroy the enemy's base. But instead of a spaceship, you're managing a big tower of artillery guns. You put out fires, repair damaged systems, target enemy systems with your guns, choose between different payloads for your artillery shells and more.

There are a few upgrades available, they range from $1 to $5 and unlock a few extra base designs as well as more guns and systems. The final upgrade gives you an excellent mortar cannon as well as a nuclear reactor - nothing game breaking, but certainly an advantage.

The game is very well designed and has multiple levels of strategy, average play time for a level goes from 5-20 minutes. Graphics are good and the AI can get pretty difficult. There is a story, but it returns back on itself in a very interesting way that makes me more than happy to play through multiple times.

Edit - also check out Robotek. It's got surprising depth and yet is approachable enough for a 5yo to play. Very good design all around.
